pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0127 against current main without reviving stale PR #242. This first producer request adds stable Sprite/Tile authoring documents, shared transactional authoring services, neutral 2D asset compilation, deterministic Sprite Animation playback, and Native 2D render extraction contracts while preserving the merged dedicated 2D physics/project-settings implementation.

Further commits on this same Draft PR integrate scene/runtime, Project Rust, Editor authoring, proving content, and validation.
